explication: Tube Archivist is a self-hosted YouTube archive for subscribing to channels, downloading videos, indexing metadata, and searching and watching the collection. The principal workflow runs from channel subscriptions through scheduled discovery and yt-dlp downloads into Elasticsearch-backed catalog indexes, then through web search and playback; Redis and Celery support transient queue and task state. The README documents these capabilities, while source references support several internal calls. Some backend view and task wiring is unsampled, so uncertain links are omitted or marked unverified.
